description: lammpkeeper.io.Box.from_dump_bounds inverts LAMMPS enclosing dump bounds: enclosing x bounds (0, 12) with xy tilt 2 describe a physical 10 x 10 x 30 A cell (volume 3000, non-orthogonal); enclosing bounds (0, 10) with the same tilt describe an 8 x 10 x 30 A cell (volume 2400). An untilted (0,10)(0,10)(0,30) box has volume 3000 and is orthogonal.
source: LAMMPS dump convention (Howto triclinic): xlo_bound = xlo + min(0, xy, xz, xy+xz), xhi_bound = xhi + max(0, xy, xz, xy+xz); volume = lx*ly*lz is invariant under shear. Confirmed against the from_dump_bounds docstring ("Invert LAMMPS enclosing bounds") on 2026-10-31. Volume tolerance rel 1e-12 (relaxed from 1e-14 on 2026-10-31 for portability; exact products today).
